events.verdict: White (BOS) avoids making any contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm as he defends the jump shot attempt.
Garza (BOS) and Wagner (ORL) briefly engage and disengage following the expiration of the pick.
Carter Jr. (ORL) contests Brown (BOS)"s jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
Walsh (BOS) extends his forearm into Banchero's (ORL) path and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Garza (BOS) is already in Bane's (ORL) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Suggs (ORL) and Brown (BOS) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Brown (BOS) moves through Suggs' (ORL) space and dislodges him from his legally obtained defensive position off-ball.
White (BOS) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Suggs (ORL) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Brown's (BOS) hand that is on the ball, as Brown receives the pass.
Garza (BOS) is firming up in Suggs' (ORL) path and does not deliver contact during the pick.
Suggs (ORL) momentarily applies his hand to Brown's (BOS) side as he navigates the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Banchero (ORL) is moving alongside Brown's (BOS) path, and the contact on the perimeter is marginal.
Bane (ORL) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) establishes himself in Walsh's (BOS) path and does not deliver contact.
Walsh (BOS) cleanly deflects the ball away from Wagner (ORL).  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.
Possession is awarded to the Magic.  Wagner (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession should have been awarded to the Celtics.
Minott (BOS) is already in Bane's (ORL) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Brown (BOS) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) initiates contact with White's (BOS) arm that affects his ability to secure the rebound.
Brown (BOS) commits a take foul on Wagner (ORL).
